name: Recursive

category: Frontier lab (automated AI research / recursive self-improvement)

founders: Richard Socher (CEO; ex-Salesforce Chief Scientist, You.com founder, highly cited NLP researcher) plus 7 co-founders: Tim Rocktäschel (UCL prof, ex-Google DeepMind principal scientist), Alexey Dosovitskiy (Vision Transformer author), Josh Tobin (ex-OpenAI), Caiming Xiong (ex-Salesforce AI research lead), Yuandong Tian (ex-Meta FAIR research director), Tim Shi (Cresta co-founder/CTO), and Jeff Clune (UBC prof; Darwin Gödel Machine, open-endedness). talentSignals: Eight-cofounder team spanning ViT, open-endedness (Clune, Rocktäschel), FAIR reasoning/RL (Tian), and early OpenAI agents (Tobin); four employees co-authored the Darwin Gödel Machine paper with Clune https://www.gv.com/news/recursive-superintelligence-self-improving-ai
